name: move toward the vertex that minimises the linearisation
mechanism: at the current feasible point minimise the linear approximation of the objective over the feasible set (a vertex), then move a fraction of the way toward that vertex, staying feasible without projection

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Frank-Wolfe algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Optimization algorithms: an iterative first-order optimization algorithm for constrained convex optimization

requires: a linear minimisation oracle over the feasible set
